newsitem.title: CHILE: Chile Feb bank earnings up on 1996, off on Jan. [CORRECTED 21:01 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Chile Feb bank earnings up on 1996, off on Jan. [CORRECTED 21:01 GMT]

text.p: Chile's banking and financial sector reported net earnings of 44 billion pesos in the first two months of the year, up nine percent on the same period 1996, said the Banks and Financial Institutions Superintendency.
But the figures showed profits were 16 percent lower last month than in January.
Loan portfolios climbed 10 percent last month with consumer credits soaring 31 percent. Mortgage loans rose 22 percent, while commercial loans were up 11 percent.
